subject: Purple Rupee
text: Blowing up the weak wall on the right after the fence ends reveals a chest containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: As you leave the city stick to the wall on your left which will eventually turn into a fence.  When the fence on your left ends, take a look at the wall on your right to find a weak area of wall.  Blow it up using one of your bombs and inside you will find a chest containing a PURPLE RUPEE.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Placing a bomb in front of an awkward section of the right wall on Death Mountain Trail opens a path to Gold Skulltula [016].

evidence.quote: Make your way up the trail while keeping an eye on the right wall, when you reach a section that looks a little bit awkward, equip your bombs and place a bomb in front of that section of wall.  The wall breaks open and reveals a very small path that leads only to a Skulltula.  Defeat the enemy with your Fairy Slingshot and then you can climb the wall it was clinging to get the GOLD SKULLTULA [016].

subject: Lon Lon Milk
text: Playing Epona's Song in front of the cow inside the hidden hole under a large rock fills Empty Bottles with Lon Lon Milk.

evidence.quote: You will come across a large rock in your path and when you destroy this rock it reveals a hole underneath.  Drop down this hole to find three things, Rupees, health and a cow.  If you like since you probably aren't using them for anything else, you can fill those two Empty Bottles with Lon Lon Milk by standing in front of the cow and playing Epona's Song on your Fairy Ocarina.

subject: Spin Attack
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem in the Great Fairy's Fountain summons the Fairy of Power, granting a magic meter and the magic Spin Attack.

evidence.quote: Similar to what you did in the graveyard, stand on the Triforce emblem and play Zelda's Lullaby.  The combination is of course left, up, right, left, up, right.  The Fairy of Power comes out of the water and grants you a sword technique.  You finally have a magic meter now and can use the magic Spin Attack.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the crate directly on the left upon entering Death Mountain Crater reveals Gold Skulltula [017].

evidence.quote: The first thing you are going to want to do here is roll into the crate directly on your left when you enter.  A Skulltula pops out of the crate when it smashes and you can kill it and then pick up the GOLD SKULLTULA [017].

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Climbing down the wall below the thin board in Death Mountain Crater leads to an opening holding Piece of Heart [008].

evidence.quote: Descend down this wall and as you go you should notice an opening in the middle, get below it and climb up to reach the inner section.  Here you will find another PIECE OF HEART [008].

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Dropping from the roof where the owl leaves Link onto the chicken coop roof cover allows access to a secret entrance with Piece of Heart [009].

evidence.quote: Directly below you should be kind of a little roof cover thing for the chicken coop, what you want to do is walk very slowly and hang off the edge, then drop onto this roof cover.  Beside you is a secret entrance into the house, take it.  Grab the PIECE OF HEART [009] here and then leave the house, I guess you could use that cow to get some Lon Lon Milk if you really wanted.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: The Bombchu Bowling Alley costs 30 Rupees per game and offers randomized prizes including Bombchus, Piece of Heart [010], and the Biggest Bomb Bag.

evidence.quote: Next door to the Shooting Gallery, the Bombchu Bowling Alley is now open for business.  Head there now, each game costs 30 Rupees and you'll likely be playing a lot so be sure to bring a lot of money with you.  Here's how it works, there are a number of prizes which are randomized.  The prizes are Bombs, Purple Rupee, Bombchus, PIECE OF HEART [010] and BIGGEST BOMB BAG, the final two are obviously the ones you'll really be working toward.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: For the third Bombchu Bowling target, stand two or three black notches left of the middle arrow and throw at a 45 degree angle to the upper right.

evidence.quote: Instead stand exactly where you would stand if it was on the far left, about two or three black notches left of the middle arrow.  Now tap the analog stick on a 45 degree angle to the upper right, or northeast then let loose.

subject: Hyrule Castle Guard
text: Approaching the gate guard at Hyrule Castle and giving him ten Rupees allows Link to pass through.

evidence.quote: If you want to save ten Rupees you can climb up the vine and drop down behind the gate, or you can just approach the guard and give him ten Rupees, he'll let you through.

subject: Din's Fire
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem in the Great Fairy's Fountain behind the rock at Hyrule Castle teaches the Din's Fire technique.

evidence.quote: Just past the gate there is a fork in the road and the path leading right leads to a large rock.  Now that you have bombs, pull one out of your bag and use it to destroy this rock standing in your way, then enter the crawlspace behind it.  This turns out to be one of the Great Fairy's Fountains...Play Zelda's Lullaby, left, up, right, left, up, right and a Fairy will appear in front of you.  She teaches you the DIN'S FIRE technique.

subject: Blue Rupee
text: Blowing up the rock directly west of the drawbridge leading into Hyrule Castle Town reveals a hole with a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Directly west of the drawbridge leading into Hyrule Castle Town there is a  
rock just sitting out there in the field, take out one of your bombs and use 
it to blast that rock to bits.  Drop down the hole that you find below the 
rock and open the small chest to acquire a BLUE RUPEE.

subject: Blue Rupee
text: Taking a right at the first fork and a left at the second in The Lost Woods leads to a boulder concealing a hole with a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Enter The Lost Woods here.  Make a right at the first fork and a left at the 
second.  Here you will come across a boulder which you can blow up using one 
of your bombs.  Down below it you will find a chest containing BLUE RUPEE.

subject: Deku Scrub
text: In a hole beneath a rock in The Lost Woods, the Deku Scrub on the left sells the Deku Nut Upgrade for 40 Rupees.

evidence.quote: There are two Deku Scrubs here, fire your Fairy Slingshot at both of them.  The one on the right is useless however the one on the left sells you the DEKU NUT UPGRADE for only 40 Rupees.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night in Kakariko Village, Gold Skulltula [018] is found crawling on the back wall of the large house on the north side.

evidence.quote: Make your way down to Kakariko Village, but before you actually go into the village, make sure it's night time.  When you enter the village, take a look on the back of the large house on the north side, it should be right near you.  Here you will find another GOLD SKULLTULA [018] crawling around on the back wall.
